text:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a spike where some v1 clients are getting routed to v2 in the EU region. Happens around 09:05 UTC, short bursts. Anyone else seeing this?

samir: saw that too. looks like a header TTL mismatch with the `x-client-version` coalescing. small % but enough to affect quota math.

linh: can you paste an example request header?

maya: sure — snippet from the proxy logs: `x-client-version: 1.0.3` then later `x-client-version: v2` on the same token after retry. suspect the proxy fallback adding `version=implicit` param.

samir: ah that rings a bell — the fallthrough heuristic we added for sticky routing will overwrite when header missing. if token affinity TTL expires and a retry comes in with `Accept: */*` it can re-eval routing and pick v2.

anne: console UX question: should we expose a tenant-level "pin version" toggle in Console so support can force v1 for affected customers?

linh: short-term yes, but we need guardrails. pin should create a route override with expiry and show telemetry estimate of delta cost/latency.

maya: agree. for immediate mitigation we can flip a soft flag: `routing.debounce.window_ms=5000` to reduce churn.

ops-bot: deploy job started: infra/flags/routing-debounce -> canary on prod-eu (10% hosts).

samir: can we validate impact? query we ran: 
```
SELECT count(*) as c, route_version
FROM requests
WHERE region='eu' AND ts > now()-interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY route_version
```
result: v1=99.2%, v2=0.8% (but spikes to 4-5% during burst windows).

linh: telemetry note: those bursts correlate with retries from SDK older than 1.0.4 — they do a 500->retry-without-header flow. we should triage SDK change too.

anne: UX: when we show "pin version" in Console, also add a warning: "pinning may affect throughput and cost; use with support" + quick link to rollback.

maya: ops-bot flagged a canary signal: 10% hosts applied debounce, latency delta < 2ms p50, error rate unchanged.

samir: nice. next steps: 1) widen debounce to 50% hosts for 1h 2) create tenant pin button behind admin role 3) add telemetry alert when implicit-version switchrate > 1%/10m.

linh: for (3) we should instrument `version_switch_rate` metric on console per-tenant and per-route and threshold at 0.5% for warning.

maya: putting PRs: routing flag change (small patch), console pin mockup (screenshot in PR), and alert rule change.

anne: can we schedule a 15-min sync after the 50% canary so support knows how to use the pin?

maya: yep — booking a quick stand at 10:30 UTC. invite: @samir @linh @anne @support.

samir: quick follow-up — should we consider changing the fallback heuristic: prefer keep-alive affinity over header when token affinity < 30s? that would cut churn.

linh: possible, but risky for edge cases where token affinity lost legitimately. prefer debounce + SDK patch first.

maya: action items summarized: 
- samir: roll debounce to 50% hosts (ETA 10:00 UTC)
- linh: add tenant-level metric `version_switch_rate` + dashboard tile (ETA EOD)
- anne: wireframe and gate for Console pin (admin-only) + warning copy (ETA next-day)
- maya: coordinate 10:30 sync and doc mitigation steps for support

anne: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy job succeeded: infra/flags/routing-debounce -> 50% hosts in prod-eu at 09:58 UTC.

maya: monitoring looks good so far. keeping this thread open for any regressions; will close after 48h no spikes.

samir: FYI, creating a short internal KB with SDK team to push a micro-patch to v1.0.4 clients that preserves `x-client-version` across retries.

linh: logging note for future: include `affinity_id` in request logs to make debugging these handoffs easier.

maya: thanks all — moving to follow-up PRs.

samir: thanks. :party_parrot:
